title: NEET UG 2026 Online Counselling
organization: Medical Counselling Committee / National Medical Commission
postName: NEET UG All India / state counselling
vacancyDetails: NEET UG All India / state counselling
qualification: NEET UG qualified as per MCC / state brochure
selectionProcess: Online form / counselling registration → Choice filling (if any) → Allotment / exam
documentsRequired: Photo, signature, educational documents, category certificate and photo ID
howToApply:
1. Visit https://mcc.nic.in/ug-medical-counselling/
2. Open the current UG Medical Counselling 2026 notice or registration link
3. Register or log in with the required NEET UG credentials
4. Complete choice filling and lock choices within the schedule shown by MCC
5. Save the submitted choices and allotment record
shortDescription: NEET UG 2026 counselling Round 2 registration started on 03 September 2026 at 1:00 PM. Check MCC for the latest schedule and registration link.
content:
Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) published the UG Medical Counselling 2026 Round 2 schedule. The official UG counselling page states that Round 2 registration was available from 03 September 2026 at 1:00 PM onwards; the reset option was available up to 07 September 2026 at 5:00 PM.

Check the MCC notice for the currently active round, choice filling, seat matrix and allotment updates.
